  - defective items was found on the warehouse,
  - buyer returns items but we can not sell them again.

Freight delivery of unclaimed return back to the Wildberries warehouse. Per 1 item.

deliveryDumpSrgOfficeExpr.description:
**Return of unknown items to the pick-up point. Per one item, ₽**

Applies to items that could not be accepted at the warehouse.

deliveryDumpSrgReturnExpr.description:

Delivery of unclaimed return back to the Wildberries warehouse.

deliveryDumpSupCourierBase.description:

Applies when:
- the seller wants to remove items from the Wildberries warehouse
- defective items are found in the warehouse
- a customer returns an item, but it cannot be returned to sale
- auto-return of items sold under the Marketplace model is enabled

- auto-return of items sold under the Marketplace model is enabled

warehouseList.description:
Return rates grouped by warehouses:
  - cost of returning defective items and returns initiated by the seller for freight delivery.
  - cost of returning items unidentified by the warehouse.
  - cost of returning defective items, returns initiated by the seller, and auto-returns by the Marketplace (to the pickup point and back).

 You can get the cost of returns to the pickup point and reverse logistics if the seller did not collect the items from the pickup point within 7 days.
